architecture.pattern: Single-process Android app: Activity-owned WebView UI + application-scoped reader state machine + two pluggable in-process TTS engines writing one shared AudioTrack + foreground media service + pure-Kotlin ad-block engine

layers.name: Browser UI
responsibilities: address bar, navigation, progress, suggestions, overflow menu
URL normalisation and non-web scheme rejection

layers.name: Extraction
responsibilities: inject Readability + extractor, await execution
parse page to tagged blocks, re-tag live DOM
density fallback, reader CSS, highlight/scroll, next-chapter detection

layers.name: Reader core
responsibilities: sentence queue, cursor, generation token, prefetch/generation-ahead, seek/pause state machine
chunking with abbreviation guards, short-fragment merge
neural text sanitisation

layers.name: TTS engines
responsibilities: engine interface
system TTS synthesised to WAV then decoded to PCM
sherpa-onnx Kokoro/Pocket with streaming callback, saturation guard, 45 s cap
model download/SHA-256/extract
WAV decode, resample, clone-clip cleanup

layers.name: Audio path
responsibilities: one AudioTrack per chapter, async writer thread, gain/limiter, 6 ms sentence fades, drain tracking + epoch
streaming spectral denoiser and low-level gate

layers.name: Playback / media
responsibilities: foreground media service, MediaSession, MediaStyle notification, wake lock, audio focus, media-key dispatch
restart-path media button receiver
notification permission and system settings entry points

layers.name: Ad blocking
responsibilities: WebView adapter (intercept/override/inject/update)
JS bridge for generic selectors
token+host indexed engine, parser, PSL, scriptlets, surrogates, self-test
cosmetic/procedural/overlay/nag/window.open filtering

layers.name: Platform services
responsibilities: SharedPreferences settings + migrations
MediaStore-backed diagnostics and crash dumps
process singleton, crash handler

dataFlow: onPageCommitVisible -> AdBlocker.inject (content.js + host cosmetic config + scriptlets)
shouldInterceptRequest -> AdBlockEngine.check -> allow (null) or empty/pixel/surrogate response
shouldOverrideUrlLoading -> $popup rules + intent:/suspicious-TLD heuristics -> block or allow
onPageFinished (deduped by lastExtractedUrl) -> WebExtractor.install(readability.js, extract.js) -> __nsExtract() -> JSON {title, blocks[i], chars}
WebExtractor: SentenceSplitter.split(max 180 chars) + mergeGroups(<24-char fragments) -> List<Reader.Block>(text, blockIndex)
Reader.setContent/appendContent -> sentences, cursor, generation; play() -> ensureEngine -> TtsEngine.prepare
Reader.pump every 500 ms: prefetch look-ahead (<=5) then generation-ahead while engine.bufferedSeconds()<12 s and submitted<cursor+8

SherpaEngine generation thread: TtsTextCleaner -> GenerationConfig(speed, silenceScale=1.0, sid, referenceAudio, numSteps=8) -> generateWithConfigAndCallback -> SampleSink (1=continue/0=stop, rail-pinned drop, 45 s cap) -> PcmPlayer.write
SystemTtsEngine worker: synthesizeToFile (45 s latch) -> WavReader.parse/resample 24 kHz -> 6 ms edge fades -> PcmPlayer.write; monitor thread waits for drain
PcmPlayer writer thread -> AudioTrack (mono 16-bit 24 kHz, low latency, 1 s ring); boundary monitor -> Reader.onSentenceDone -> cursor++
cursor change -> notifyHighlight -> extract.js __nsHighlight (data-ns class + smooth scrollIntoView) and notifyState -> MainActivity player card + PlaybackService MediaSession/notification/wake lock
threads: main/UI: Reader state machine (Handler), engine callbacks re-posted to main, WebView, all views
ns-adblock-load: parse ~168k filter lines, build immutable engine
ns-sherpa-gen: TTS text clean + native generation + PcmPlayer.write
ns-sherpa-mon: per-sentence drain wait (250 ms poll)
ns-system-mon: per-sentence drain wait (500 ms poll)
ns-pcm-writer: sole AudioTrack writer, applies sentence tail ramps
model install thread (SettingsActivity): download + SHA-256 + tar.bz2 extract with progress
adblock list update thread (SettingsActivity): sequential HTTPS downloads + validation + reload

Prefs: all persisted settings, adblock allowlist, recent URLs, notification-asked flag

architecture.diagramHints: Draw 8 horizontal bands (Browser UI -> WebView+Extraction -> Reader -> TTS engines -> Audio path -> Playback/Media -> Ad blocking side-car -> Platform services). Arrows: WebView<->WebExtractor (JS bridge), Reader->Engine (speak), Engine->PcmPlayer (PCM), Reader->PlaybackService (state), AdBlocker<->WebView (intercept/inject), Prefs/DiagLog cross-cutting. Mark the 12 s / 8-sentence buffer and the epoch cancellation edges as the two stateful contracts.

components.name: NovelSpeakApp
components.responsibility: Application singleton; crash handler writes /sdcard/Download/novelspeak-crash.txt via MediaStore; owns Prefs, PcmPlayer, Reader; initialises AdBlocker

components.name: MainActivity
components.responsibility: WebView browser + player card + reader/site dialogs + auto-advance + insets + hand-drawn icon system

components.name: WebExtractor
components.responsibility: Script injection ordering, JSON->blocks, sentence split + short-fragment merge, highlight/scroll, reader toggle, next link

components.name: extract.js
components.responsibility: Readability + density fallback, data-ns tagging of live DOM, reader CSS (~140 rules), highlight/scroll, 4-strategy next-chapter finder, dotted-obfuscation normalisation

components.name: readability.js
components.responsibility: Vendored Mozilla Readability (Apache-2.0, based on Arc90 1.7.1)

components.name: Reader
components.responsibility: Engine-agnostic state machine: queue, cursor, generation token, prefetch + 12 s generation-ahead, seek/pause, listeners

components.name: SentenceSplitter
components.responsibility: Chunking with abbreviation/decimal/initial guards, boundary-preferring wrap, short-fragment merge groups

components.name: TtsEngine
components.responsibility: prepare/speak/stop/release/voices/setVoice/bufferedSeconds contract

components.name: SystemTtsEngine
components.responsibility: android.speech.tts; synthesizeToFile->WAV->PCM in-process so media keys and screen-off work; direct-speak fallback; per-sentence boundary monitor

components.name: SherpaEngine
components.responsibility: sherpa-onnx OfflineTts Kokoro/Pocket; streaming callback with 1/0 contract, rail-pinned drop, 45 s cap; NNAPI-or-CPU provider with CPU retry; GenerationConfig incl. referenceAudio

components.name: TtsTextCleaner
components.responsibility: Neural input sanitiser: NFKC, quote removal, glyph allowlist, ellipsis/dash->pause, punct-only skip, EOS guarantee

components.name: ModelManager
components.responsibility: Two pinned models (Kokoro 103 MB, Pocket 98 MB): download with redirects, SHA-256 verify, tar.bz2 extract with progress + 45 s stall watchdog, storage pre-check, install/delete

components.name: WavReader
components.responsibility: RIFF PCM 8/16/24/32 + float decode, mono mix, linear resample, peak normalise, 80 Hz HPF, trim silence, 30 s / 720k sample cap

components.name: PcmPlayer
components.responsibility: One AudioTrack per chapter (USAGE_MEDIA, SPEECH, mono 16-bit, low latency, 1 s ring), async writer thread, OUTPUT_GAIN 2.2 limiter, 6 ms sentence fades, drain/epoch tracking

components.name: AudioDsp
components.responsibility: Streaming denoiser: 512/256 STFT, minimum-statistics noise floor (1.02 s), decision-directed Wiener gain with -16.5 dB floor, sqrt-Hann OLA, bootstrap fix, downward expander gate

components.name: PlaybackService
components.responsibility: Foreground media service (mediaPlayback), MediaSession + MediaStyle notification, PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK while playing, audio focus, media-key dispatch, START_NOT_STICKY

components.name: MediaButtonReceiver
components.responsibility: Manifest receiver for restart/no-session media keys: ACTION_DOWN only, repeat 0, 26+ limited to PLAY/PLAY_PAUSE/HEADSETHOOK

components.name: AppPermissions
components.responsibility: POST_NOTIFICATIONS ask-once, notification/channel/app/battery settings intents, status strings

components.name: Prefs
components.responsibility: 17 settings, 4 tuning migrations, adblock allowlist, notification flag, 8 recent URLs, 11 Kokoro voices

components.name: DiagLog
components.responsibility: Log to /sdcard/Download/novelspeak-log.txt via MediaStore (API 29+) or app-external fallback; stale-row repair; recovered crash merge; logcat mirror

components.name: SettingsActivity
components.responsibility: Engine/model/voice/tuning/reading/permissions/adblock UI; model install runner with wake lock + keep-screen-on + elapsed ticker; adblock list update runner

components.name: AdBlocker
components.responsibility: WebView adapter: background list load + atomic engine swap, intercept, popup/redirect/intent guard with suspicious-TLD heuristic, JS-dialog suppression, cosmetic injection, bridge rate limit, list updates, stats broadcast

components.name: AdBlockBridge
components.responsibility: Only JS interface: bounded lookup (<=32 KB, <=400 names, 25 calls/s) and hidden-count reporter

components.name: AdBlockEngine
components.responsibility: Immutable token+host+regex-prefix indexed matcher; $important/$badfilter/exception precedence; cosmetic + generic selector lookup; WildcardMatcher for ABP * and ^

components.name: FilterParser
components.responsibility: ABP/uBO line parser: network options, cosmetic separators/actions, procedural parse, badfilter FNV-1a canonical hash; unsupported options drop the rule

components.name: adblock support files
components.responsibility: Resource types/models, URL/host/token/type-from-Accept helpers, PSL registrable-domain/sameSite, 7 scriptlets, 10 surrogates, 22-assertion deterministic self-test

components.name: content.js
components.responsibility: In-page cosmetic engine: batched CSS insertion, procedural filters (:has-text/:matches-css/:upward/:xpath + actions), MutationObserver class/id lookup via bridge, overlay heuristic, fake-nag/iframe-nag removal, window.open neutralisation

components.name: UrlInput
components.responsibility: Address-bar normaliser: http(s)/about only, 13 non-web schemes converted to search, host detection

capabilities.note: Device system TTS (all installed voices/languages) plus offline Kokoro (11 English voices) and Pocket; speed 0.5-2.0x effective

No server integration beyond model/list downloads; privacy-positive, no cross-device resume

capabilities.anchor: none in app/src or assets JS
capabilities.note: No translation or dictionary feature
No file writer or encoder; README roadmap #5
Ad-block allowlist is truly per registrable domain; the site dialog's Reader-mode item writes the global pref; no per-site extractor rules/cache
No sentence/minute counters or stats UI
contentDescriptions and 40-56 dp targets, but fixed 17 px reader CSS, no dynamic type, no TalkBack state announcements, colour-only highlight
Single-column phone layout; no window-size-class logic, no multi-pane; rotation handled only via configChanges
No first-run tour; opens empirenovel immediately; notification ask deferred to first Play
No IAP, subscription or ads code paths
Local-only crash + rolling log in Download; zero remote reporting, zero third-party SDKs (support weakness, privacy strength)

Scheme allowlist, cleartext off, debug-gated CDP, immutable PendingIntents; but MIXED_CONTENT_COMPATIBILITY, third-party cookies, always-on JS bridge, exported MediaButtonReceiver, allowBackup unscoped, no WebView pause/destroy/saveState
4 host-JVM harnesses + in-app self-test; no instrumentation tests, no CI, no Gradle build
WebView LOAD_DEFAULT cache only; extracted chapter text is discarded outside the live queue
No strings.xml or values-* resources; English-only UI

strengths: Reads arbitrary web pages (Readability + density fallback + live-DOM re-tagging + 4 next-chapter strategies), not just shared text - the gap the reference apps never solved
Both TTS engines own their audio in-process (system TTS rendered to PCM), so headset keys, lock-screen transport and screen-off playback work identically on the zero-download backend
Real streaming pipeline with bounded memory: prefetch look-ahead plus 12 s / 8-sentence generation-ahead and an async PCM writer that keeps AudioTrack off the synthesis thread
Evidence-backed neural text safety: quote glyphs removed before synthesis, short-fragment merging, int8 rail-pinning detector and 45 s cap, each tied to upstream issue evidence

Measured, hand-written DSP: 512/256 STFT denoiser with minimum statistics, decision-directed Wiener gain and a floor that avoids musical noise; p20 noise floor improved -51.6 to -80.3 dBFS with speech level unchanged
A real ad-block engine in pure Kotlin: 122,884 network / 32,403 cosmetic / 4,612 scriptlet rules, token+host indexing, procedural filters, scriptlets, surrogates, PSL, deterministic 22/22 self-test

Hermetic framework-only build (29 files, 9,746 Kotlin lines, no AndroidX, no Gradle, no Play services) that can be rebuilt on-device with build.sh; only network destinations are pages, the GitHub model release and filter-list hosts
Rare verification culture at this scale: measured numbers with artefacts, SHA-256-pinned models, host harnesses and a user-runnable self-test instead of adb-only claims
weaknesses: No reading-position persistence: cold start restores only last_url; the sentence cursor lives in memory, so Android process death loses the place
No library, history, bookmarks, notes or saved highlights - only 8 recent URLs
Pause is a restart: the current sentence is re-synthesised from its start (documented and peer-consistent, but up to ~12 s of replay at 180-char chunks)
Site dialog item 'Reader mode' writes the global preference, so a control labelled per-site is not per-site (correctness/UX bug)
Speed UI allows 2.5x while both engines clamp to 2.0x - silent mismatch
No ingestion path from other apps (no ACTION_SEND/ACTION_PROCESS_TEXT filter), so text the user already has cannot be read
Single live engine with no LRU cache: every switch back to neural pays a ~100 MB model load
No WebView lifecycle: no onPause/onResume/destroy or saveState, so page JS keeps running with the screen off (battery) and the WebView leaks on activity recreation
Engine errors are terminal (playing=false, service stopped) with no retry or runtime fallback to system TTS
Doc/code drift: PcmPlayer header cites CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC and buffer=max(pcmBytes,4096) while the code uses CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH and a 1 s ring; OPTIMIZATIONS.md repeats the stale buffer claim
Per-line synchronous MediaStore logging on the synthesis thread (DiagLog.line at sentence start/end)
No automated coverage for Reader/engine interaction, auto-advance or PlaybackService; no CI workflows
Two duplicated hand-rolled design systems (palette + widget builders) and programmatic views, raising the cost of adaptive/tablet layouts later
Exported MediaButtonReceiver with no permission and no permission guard - needless attack surface and a store-review question
WebView permissive where not required: mixed-content COMPATIBILITY mode and third-party cookies on for all sites; NSAdBlock JS bridge attached unconditionally
allowBackup=true with no backup rules, so prefs and (within quota) filesDir models enter Android Auto Backup
No remote crash visibility (local Download file only), so field failures are invisible unless the user shares the file
Model/filter-list licences are only on disk (NOTICE.txt) - no in-app attribution surface
Verification is single-environment: one API 35 emulator plus one iqoo I2214 (Android 15); no Android 7-12, tablet, foldable or 32-bit data
Build is reproducible but not one-command: hand-fetched android.jar (API 34), sherpa AAR and R8 9.5.28
